tools.name: claix.schemas.create
tools.title: Create Claix schema
tools.description: Create a Claix schema (POST /api/create-schema). Requires name, type (excel-json, json-excel, pdf-json, doc-json, img-json, txt-json, audio-json) and schema_definition. Optional: is_agent_mode, agent_definition, resumen_agent, window_context (Guardar Datos: when true, JSON extractions insert a mapped row into the connected DB; needs connection + mapping rules; default false), source verification (default false).

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

name.description: Human-readable schema name. Example: Facturas HTML.

type.description: Schema type matching an extraction endpoint. Example: txt-json, pdf-json.

schema_definition.description: Output fields. Each key is a JSON property; each value is { type: "string"|"integer"|"number"|"boolean", description: "..." }.

is_agent_mode.description: Set true to enable Agent mode. json-excel cannot use Agent mode.

agent_definition.description: Required if is_agent_mode is true. Types: boolean, string, closed, integer. closed requires options[].

window_context.description: Guardar Datos / Save Data. When true, JSON extractions insert a mapped row into the connected DB (needs connection + mapping rules). Default false.

cita_por_campo.description: Enables source verification: each extracted field (and agent_data) is returned as {value, source} instead of a bare value. Defaults to false.

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

data.description: JSON payload from the Claix API (extracted records, schema list, or Excel export metadata).

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.

tools.name: claix.multi_document.ask
tools.title: Ask across multiple documents
tools.description: Ask up to 5 typed questions across up to 10 uploaded documents (POST /multi-document). Multipart: repeat field file for each document; questions as a JSON string of { question, format } (format: string|int|boolean|timestamp|array). Optional window_context, window_time, space_id match OpenAPI MultiDocumentRequest. Returns user_ask, ia_response, documents_processed, log_id.

api_key.description: API key secreta de Claix. Ejemplo: claix_sk_abc123.... Opcional si la conexión MCP envía x-api-key en cabecera HTTP (recomendado en Smithery/Cursor).

question.description: Question text answered from the uploaded documents only.

format.description: Expected JSON type for the matching ia_response item: string, int, boolean, timestamp, or array.

items.description: Typed question. Example: {"question":"¿Cuál es el importe total?","format":"int"}

questions.description: Questions as objects { question, format }. Max 5 per call, 400 characters per question. format ∈ string|int|boolean|timestamp|array.

file_base64.description: Archivo codificado en Base64. Acepta data URLs (data:application/pdf;base64,...) o Base64 puro. Ejemplo de uso: adjunta el PDF/imagen del chat como Base64 antes de llamar a extract_*.

file_path.description: URL HTTPS pública del archivo a procesar. Ejemplo: https://cdn.example.com/factura.pdf. No uses rutas locales del PC del usuario.

filename.description: Nombre original del archivo con extensión. Ejemplo: factura-2026-03.pdf. Ayuda a inferir el MIME cuando envías file_base64.

items.description: One uploaded document. Provide file_base64 or file_path; optional filename.

files.description: Up to 10 documents. Each is sent as multipart field file.

window_context.description: Optional OpenAPI MultiDocumentRequest flag: when true, converted documents may be retained.

window_time.description: Required by API if window_context is true. Minutes or "infinity".

space_id.description: Optional OpenAPI MultiDocumentRequest space_id (only when window_context is true).

success.description: True when Claix returned a successful response. False when isError is set on the tool result.

error.description: Human-readable error message when success is false.
